pages.title: Darling Doll
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Darling Doll lets you design a paper doll and dress it in your own style. Start with the character, then try hairstyles, outfits and accessories from the wardrobe. Put together a chibi look or make a fashion doll with a more formal outfit. Change any piece as you work toward the combination you like.

pages.title: Shoot 2048 Hexa
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Shoot 2048 Hexa turns number merging into an aiming puzzle. Fire a numbered hexagon toward one with the same value to create a larger number. Look for shots that make a match and leave enough room for later tiles. Keep merging as the board fills and try to raise your score.

pages.title: Pet Merge
pages.creator: PT Arena Solusi Digital
pages.description: Pet Merge lets you combine pets to discover new creatures. Look for companions you can merge and work toward rarer species as your collection grows. Choose Adventure to play through levels or Classic to see how high a score you can reach. Each new pet gives you another kind to look for.

pages.title: Math Duck
pages.creator: Orenji Spark
pages.description: Math Duck gives you shuffled number cards to combine into totals of ten. Each correct total becomes an attack against an enemy. Defeat enemies to gain experience and level up, then pick one of three upgrades. Your arithmetic choices determine when the duck can attack, and the upgrades change how it fights later in the run.

pages.title: Speedrun platformer
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Speedrun platformer gives you levels to finish as quickly as possible. Jump across the course, collect coins and land on monsters' heads to get them out of the way. Look for a route that gets you past the obstacles without wasting time. Finish quickly enough to earn a place on the leaderboard.

pages.title: Gun Rush
pages.creator: Online Games
pages.description: Gun Rush combines a running course with weapon merging. Steer around obstacles, collect guns and shoot your way toward the finish. Choose gates that raise useful stats such as damage, firing speed or range. Watch the route for the next weapon or upgrade before deciding which side of the course to take.

pages.title: Fashion Challenge: Catwalk Run
pages.creator: CD GAMES
pages.description: Fashion Challenge: Catwalk Run gives you a new style theme for each catwalk challenge. Pick clothes, accessories and a hairstyle that fit the theme, then see how the judges score the look. Travel to different fashion shows and unlock more outfits as you earn points. Try to climb the leaderboard with your styling choices.

pages.title: Mafia Roulette
pages.creator: DarkPlay
pages.description: Mafia Roulette pits you against the mafia in a game of cards and chance. You each start with five lives, and your opening three cards can change the round. Use them to deal or block damage, draw or steal cards, or change a rule. Decide when to bet tokens and when to keep your options open for later.

pages.title: Halloween Stickman
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Halloween Stickman gives you the power to rewind time after a trickster gets you into trouble on Halloween. Use what you learn from one outcome to change what happens on the next attempt. Watch where the setup goes wrong, then go back and try a different response to turn the prank against him.

pages.title: Color Rings Block Puzzle
pages.creator: MINDWAYTECH CONSULTING SERVICES PRIVATE LIMITED
pages.description: Color Rings Block Puzzle is a color-matching game played on a board. Place the colored rings and look for matches that clear them from play. Each placement changes what you can do with the rings that come next. Keep usable spaces open while you set up matches and try to beat your high score.

pages.title: Microplastics Feeding
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Microplastics Feeding sends a hungry fish through the ocean in search of plastic. Guide it toward the plastic objects in the water and help it eat every one it can find. Look around for pieces you may have passed while following another item. The goal is to clear the plastic from the scene.

pages.title: Draw Wheels
pages.creator: VarCo
pages.description: Draw Wheels asks you to design the wheels your bike will use in a race. Sketch a shape and watch what it does when the bike starts moving. A shape that works well on one stretch may handle differently on another. Experiment with your drawings to find a wheel that helps you reach the finish first.

pages.title: Thanksgiving Squad Style
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Thanksgiving Squad Style lets you put together outfits for friends celebrating Thanksgiving. Browse the wardrobe for warm layers and festive accents, then decide how to combine them for each character. Try a shared palette for the squad or give each friend a different seasonal look. Finish the outfits before they gather for the celebration.

pages.title: L.O.L. Surprise! O.M.G.™ Fashion House
pages.creator: MGA
pages.description: L.O.L. Surprise! O.M.G.™ Fashion House lets you move into a house with Neon Licious, Royal Bee, Swag or Lady Diva. Explore the rooms, keep your doll rested and fed, and choose outfits for photoshoots. Play mini-games such as BB Driver and Outfit Memory. As you explore, you can also unlock other dolls, including 24k DJ and Busy BB.

pages.title: Make Up Queen R
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Make Up Queen R asks you to recreate the makeup shown on a model. Watch the application and stop it at the right moment to match the example. A result that misses the look can end the run at that stage. There are three stages, each with a different model to copy.

pages.title: Traffic Racer Pro Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Traffic Racer Pro Online lets you drive through traffic in One Way, Two Way, Time Attack and Speed Bomb challenges. Watch the road ahead as you pass other cars and earn money. Spend your earnings on another car or change details such as the paint, tires, gears and wheels on the one you have.

pages.title: Space Module
pages.creator: XiferGames
pages.description: Space Module puts you in charge of a spacecraft that you can build up from its components. Fight enemy ships and collect the loot they leave behind. Buy and upgrade parts to expand your ship, but consider what a larger build changes. The bigger it gets, the easier it is for enemies to spot.

pages.title: Round N Round
pages.creator: Ramblo Digital Media
pages.description: Round N Round puts you on a circular path with bullets coming toward it. Change your direction when the route ahead is about to cross a shot. Watch the timing before making another turn. The challenge is staying on the ring and reacting quickly enough to avoid the next bullet.

pages.title: Helicopter Rescue
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Helicopter Rescue puts you in a third-person rescue mission. Shoot the enemies pursuing the hostages before they can catch up with them. Watch who is closest to the escape route and choose where to aim next. Your job is to cover the hostages long enough for them to get away safely.

pages.title: Spiny maze puzzle
pages.creator: BestGameSpot
pages.description: Spiny maze puzzle gives you a circular maze and a small ball to guide into a hole. Rotate the maze with the arrow keys or touch either side of the screen to turn it in that direction. Watch where the ball rolls before turning again. There are thirty layouts to solve.

pages.title: Tanks Zone io
pages.creator: JetGames
pages.description: Tanks Zone io puts your tank in an arena with other players. Fight for space and improve your weapons while the battle is going on. Try a flamethrower, machine gun or double cannon as you adjust to the next threat. You can team up with other players to take on opponents together.

pages.title: Police Car Simulator
pages.creator: Inspector Studios
pages.description: Police Car Simulator lets you drive a patrol car through a 3D city. Use the arrow keys to steer through traffic and take on driving missions along the way. The car has a police siren. Watch the road around you as you move through intersections and get to your next assignment.

pages.title: Dice Merge
pages.creator: Eternal Game
pages.description: Dice Merge gives you a five-by-five wooden board for placing dice. Rotate a piece before setting it down if that helps it fit. Put three matching dice together to merge them, and look for a placement that can set off another match. Leave enough open tiles for the next pieces as you build your score.

pages.title: Prisonela
pages.creator: Stickman vs Monster School Team
pages.description: Prisonela is an endless platform game set in a prison. Get through each stage and stay alive as the game chooses another layout at random. Watch the route before making a jump, since the next room may ask you to react to something you have not just seen. See how far you can make it through the sequence.

pages.title: Ninja Robo Hero
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: Ninja Robo Hero follows superhero robots fighting an invasion of their city. Choose a robot and work through battles against the invaders. After a level, improve your fighter's skills or unlock another robot to try. Use those changes as you take on the next group of enemies and keep defending the city.

pages.title: Potato Chips Simulator
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: Potato Chips Simulator takes you through making potato chips from the field to the store. Plant the potatoes, then work through the steps that turn them into a snack. Put the finished chips on the shelves to sell them. Each stage takes care of one part of getting the product ready for the market.

pages.title: Constellation Energy Lines
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Constellation Energy Lines asks you to connect stars in one continuous stroke. Look at the whole constellation before making the first move, and choose a route that reaches every star without lifting your input. A path that reaches most of them can still leave one out, so plan how you will finish before you start.

pages.title: Sokogem
pages.creator: Misc.261 Games
pages.description: Sokogem asks you to help a little creature slide gems into chests. Look at where a gem will end up after you move it, then plan how to get it into a chest from there. Work through the remaining gems without leaving one out of reach. Fill the chests to open the next puzzle.

pages.title: IN OUT
pages.creator: nau.studio
pages.description: IN OUT asks you to switch positions to avoid obstacles. Watch what is coming and change sides when your current route is about to be blocked. The difficulty increases as you play, so look ahead before making each switch. See how long you can keep going without running into anything.

pages.title: Draw Blocks 3D
pages.creator: Ohayō
pages.description: Draw Blocks 3D challenges you to draw cubes that fit into gaps. Look at the empty spaces before drawing so your blocks fill the right part of the layout. You have limited time to make the choice. Fit the cubes into the current pattern and move on to the next one.

pages.title: Match Adventure
pages.creator: Overmobile
pages.description: Match Adventure follows Gemmy the squirrel after the forest is damaged and her brother Johnny disappears. Solve match-three puzzles as you help her investigate. Talk to forest inhabitants and piece together what happened, then travel with Gemmy and her friends to other worlds. Follow the clues to learn more about Johnny's disappearance.

pages.title: Color Puzzle
pages.creator: Nevar Games
pages.description: Color Puzzle gives you a board to paint and an example to copy. Move the stick figures to apply their colors to the blocks. Check where one color ends and another begins in the example before making your next move. Finish when the pattern on your board matches the one shown.

pages.title: Domino Battle
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Domino Battle lets you play dominoes under Draw or Block rules. Take turns adding a tile whose number matches an open end. In Draw, you can take another tile when you cannot play. In Block, a turn with no legal move is passed. Look at which numbers your tiles can leave open for the next turn.

pages.title: Onet Number
pages.creator: Gamesonline.co.id
pages.description: Onet Number asks you to connect pairs of tiles with the same number. Look across the board for matching values from one to twenty-one and make each connection when you find it. Removing a pair changes what you can reach next. Keep linking tiles to see how high a score you can earn.

pages.title: Piggy On The Run
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Piggy On The Run sends a pig through a forest full of enemies and obstacles. Watch what is ahead and guide the pig past each hazard on the way through the level. A clear stretch may lead straight into another challenge, so keep looking ahead. Get through the jungle one stage at a time.

pages.title: Get 12
pages.creator: Gamesonline.co.id
pages.description: Get 12 is a number-merging puzzle. Bring two tiles of the same value together to make a new number, then look for another pair you can combine. Check what the merge will leave behind before choosing the next move. Work toward making a 12 by planning several merges ahead.

pages.title: Spooky Bubble Shooter
pages.creator: Wanted 5 Games B.V.
pages.description: Spooky Bubble Shooter asks you to free the Cherry Monster by clearing bubbles before time runs out. Aim a shot at bubbles of the same color and look for matches that open more space. Keep an eye on the clock while working through the group. Clear the play area to finish the rescue.

pages.title: Mahjong Ornaments
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Mahjong Ornaments gives you a timed layout to clear by selecting matching pairs. Choose tiles that have an open left or right side, then use the gaps they leave to reach others. A hint can help you find a pair. Finish quickly and save unused hints to earn bonus points.

pages.title: Trials Ice Ride
pages.creator: SDV Imants Klava
pages.description: Trials Ice Ride puts you on a motorcycle on an icy obstacle course. Control the bike's balance as you ride over each obstacle and try to keep the rider from falling. Finish quickly to improve your score, and work toward achievements as you complete the tracks. Watch the next landing before speeding up.

pages.title: Christmas Float Connect
pages.creator: GamesFine.com
pages.description: Christmas Float Connect asks you to link pairs of matching holiday tiles along a path with at most two right-angle turns. Tiles can shift or split after a match on some boards. Check their new positions before choosing again. Clear all 27 levels, and finish within the timer for extra points.

pages.title: Cartoon Autumn Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Cartoon Autumn Puzzle gives you six autumn pictures to reassemble. Choose one and set the puzzle to 16, 36, 64 or 100 pieces. Look for leaves, outlines and background colors that continue across neighboring fragments. Try a larger piece count when you want to solve the same picture with more pieces.

pages.title: Smiling Glass
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Smiling Glass gives you a glass to fill with water. Watch how the water flows past barriers and spikes before deciding how to get enough into the glass. Each layout has a target amount. Reach that level of water to finish the puzzle and move on to a different arrangement.

pages.title: Save the Lady 2
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Save the Lady 2 puts a woman in a series of predicaments with an alien in pursuit. Look at what is happening in the scene, then choose the answer that could get her to safety. Each choice changes what happens next. Work through the situations and keep the alien from catching her.

pages.title: Panda&Pao
pages.creator: SUCCESS Corporation
pages.description: Panda&Pao tests how quickly you can tap parts of a panda in the correct sequence. Read the current order and follow it without losing time. Finishing one stage gives you another to try while the same countdown is running. See how many sequences you can complete before the time runs out.

pages.title: Roshambo
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Roshambo is Rock Paper Scissors for a match against a friend or the computer. Pick rock, paper or scissors and see how it fares against the other player's choice. The first to score three points wins. Use the keyboard or touch controls to make your choices and see whether you can anticipate the next one.

pages.title: Fashion Nail Salon
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Fashion Nail Salon gives you nails to color and decorate. Choose shades and designs, then apply them with the mouse or touch controls. Try using one color across the whole set or changing the design from nail to nail. Mix the available options until the manicure has the look you want.

pages.title: Spike Rings
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: In Spike Rings, keep a spiked ring clear of the lines as it moves. Click or tap to control the ring and watch the space between its edges and the lines. The direction can change and the pace rises as you play, so adjust your timing to keep the run going.

pages.title: Flappy Crazy Bird
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Flappy Crazy Bird asks you to guide a bird through the part of the screen that matches its color. Watch both the bird's position and the colors ahead before making your next move. Get to the right opening in time to keep flying. See how far you can get as the course continues.

pages.title: Flappy Plane
pages.creator: pyxel and soft
pages.description: Flappy Plane puts an airplane into a course inspired by Flappy Bird. Make the plane rise at the right moment and guide it through the openings without clipping an obstacle. Watch the height of the next gap before changing your flight. Keep passing obstacles to see how far the plane can go.

pages.title: Stack Ball 2
pages.creator: Gamearcade.org
pages.description: Stack Ball 2 sends a ball down a tower of rotating platforms. Hold or tap to smash through colored sections, and avoid hitting black ones during a normal drop. A hit on black can shatter the ball and restart the attempt. Build up a fireball at full speed to break through the sections that usually stop you.

pages.title: Cannon Shoot Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Cannon Shoot Online gives you a cannon and buckets to fill. Move objects in the layout to change where the balls travel after a shot. Look at where they will bounce or roll, then adjust the route until every bucket can receive balls. Finish levels to unlock more cannons.

pages.title: Rickshaw Driver
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Rickshaw Driver puts you on a tricycle picking up passengers around a city. Follow the arrow to find the person waiting for a ride, then take them to their requested stop. Watch where the arrow points after pickup, since your destination changes. Complete the trip before moving on to the next customer.

pages.title: Music Rush
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Music Rush gives you a rolling ball to steer along a musical course. Hold and drag to move it toward other balls of the same color. Watch the upcoming colors so you can choose a route before the next group reaches you. Collect hats and designs to change how your ball looks.

pages.title: Rainbow Fish Coloring
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Rainbow Fish Coloring gives you eight fish pictures and a palette to use on them. Choose a drawing and click or tap the areas you want to color. Try different shades across the fish and its surroundings. When the image is finished, select the camera button to download it.

pages.title: Color Falling Balls
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: Color Falling Balls asks you to change the color of a large ball before smaller ones touch it. Click or tap to switch colors, then check the next ball approaching from around the screen. Both balls must match when they meet. A mismatch ends the attempt, so keep watching as the arrivals speed up.

pages.title: Masked Forces Ancient Serpents
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Masked Forces Ancient Serpents is a shooter with combat missions and gear to unlock. Aim with the mouse and left-click to shoot, or use the number keys to switch weapons during a fight. Between missions, you can try different weapon skins and equip armor with abilities that suit the next objective.

pages.title: Moon Car Stunt
pages.creator: sienar games
pages.description: Moon Car Stunt lets you drive on stunt courses set in space. Take on the timer in single-player mode and try to finish the route before time runs out. You can also play against a friend on a split screen. Watch the course ahead to line up the next stretch before you get there.

pages.title: Sports Cars Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Sports Cars Slide gives you three pictures of sports cars in sliding puzzles. Pick an image and one of three modes, then move the pieces around until the picture is restored. Look at the lines of the car and the background as you decide which section needs to go next.

pages.title: Hipsters vs Rockers
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Hipsters vs Rockers has Gaia, Ero and Ai try two styles. Choose clothes for a hipster look, then try the rocker options and compare how they suit each friend. Use the mouse to browse the choices and change pieces. See how a different combination changes the look for the same character.

pages.title: Tank Battle Arena
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Tank Battle Arena offers three ways to fight. In Classic, take out the enemy tank on different maps. In Capture the Flag, get into enemy territory and bring its flag back to your side. Death Match gives you two minutes to earn the highest score you can. Choose the objective you want before taking your tank into battle.

pages.title: Boat & Dash!
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Boat & Dash! sends a boat along a route with crates, wheels, barrels and rocks. Guide the boat with the mouse and smash the breakable objects as you go. Steer away from the rocks, since hitting one ends the attempt. Get through the route to take on the more demanding courses.

pages.title: Halloween Jigsaw Deluxe
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Halloween Jigsaw Deluxe asks you to rebuild Halloween pictures against a clock. Drag pieces into place and look for details that continue from one fragment to the next. Work on a recognizable part of the image first if the layout is hard to read. Complete the picture before the time limit.

pages.title: Archery
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Archery gives you targets at different distances to shoot with a bow. Use the mouse to aim and send an arrow toward the target, then see how the shot lands. Earn coins as you hit targets. Spend them on new bows, arrows or upgrades before trying to improve your next set of shots.

pages.title: Police Chase Real Cop Driver
pages.creator: gamesfog
pages.description: In Police Chase Real Cop Driver, patrol an open world and respond to jobs that range from vehicle rescues to helicopter pursuits. Complete missions to earn cash and unlock more cars. Take your patrol through city streets, overpasses and outlying areas as you head to the next call.

pages.title: Gravity Kid
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Gravity Kid puts you in anti-gravity shoes with a police officer chasing you. Keep running, use the shoes to get past gaps and obstacles, and collect coins to improve your skills. Pickups include shields, coin magnets and a potion that slows the action. Learn the controls in the tutorial before attempting a longer run.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Naughty Cat
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Baby Hazel Naughty Cat follows Hazel as she spends a day with Katy, her mischievous cat. Help Hazel with the bath and interact with both characters as the activities unfold. Keep an eye on Katy, who can get upset quickly. Work through the tasks while Hazel tries to look after her.

pages.title: Cute Diva Makeover
pages.creator: Girls Games
pages.description: Cute Diva Makeover puts you in charge of a makeover for Annie. Choose makeup, browse the clothes and add accessories that go with the outfit. Use the mouse to try the choices and swap anything you want to change. Decide what to keep once the different parts of her look come together.

pages.title: Lolirockstars Maker
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Lolirockstars Maker lets you create looks for the members of a rock band. Choose a hairstyle, outfit and accessories for each performer, then pick a song. You can also change the color of many items. Give the band a shared stage style or use different colors and clothes for each member.

pages.title: Penguin.io
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: In Penguin.io, steer your penguin across the ice as other penguins crowd around you. Keep an eye on the edge while you move through the group and look for open space where you can stay on the ice. Use the mouse to guide your penguin as the other players move around you.

pages.title: Futuristic Cars
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Futuristic Cars lets you rebuild jigsaw pictures of futuristic vehicles. Choose an image and drag the pieces into their places, looking at the shape of the car and the lines in the background. If you get stuck, try the tools the puzzle provides. Finish one image and pick another from the selection.

pages.title: Brick Block Game
pages.creator: CD GAMES
pages.description: Brick Block Game gives you falling shapes to fit into complete rows. Use Left and Right to move a piece, Up to rotate it and Down to lower it. Touch controls are also available. Clear rows to leave room for future pieces, and check how each placement will affect the spaces above it.

pages.title: Zombie Target Shoot
pages.creator: AdoLuxGames
pages.description: Zombie Target Shoot gives you fifty shots at a carnival shooting gallery. Aim at the zombie targets and try to make each round of ammunition count. A direct hit to an eye is worth more, so decide when to go for the smaller target. See how high a score you can reach before the shots run out.

pages.title: EG Nutmeg Football
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Nutmeg Football asks you to shoot a soccer ball between a player's legs. Line up the angle and click when there is a clear path through. Watch the opening before firing, because the game speeds up as you continue. Keep sending the ball through the gap as the timing gets harder.

pages.title: TENKYU 2
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: TENKYU 2 asks you to guide a ball through 3D stages by tilting the surface beneath it. Use the mouse to tilt the layout and watch how the ball rolls as the angle changes. Make smaller adjustments near turns or edges. Bring the ball to the goal and into the hole to finish.

pages.title: Valentines Love Trouble
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: In Valentines Love Trouble, help the prince steal a kiss while the other princess looks away. Hold to keep the couple kissing and release when she is about to turn back. Each kiss adds to the progress bar. Find enough chances to fill it before time runs out or the couple gets caught.

pages.title: Kids House Cleaning
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Kids House Cleaning gives you household messes to put right. Clean away the dirt and return objects to their places as you work through the activities. Look around the room to see what is still out of order before moving on. The goal is to leave the house clean and tidy.

pages.title: Halloween Monster
pages.creator: Gaming Club
pages.description: Halloween Monster challenges you to keep a character clear of obstacles by jumping. Tap the screen when you need to get over a barrier. Look at the distance to the next obstacle and decide when to jump so you can clear it safely. Keep going without letting the monster collide with anything.

pages.title: Agent of Descend
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Agent of Descend sends you down through floors filled with enemies. Choose an action each turn and take out the enemies in the room before moving lower. Buy weapons and gear and improve the agent's skills between fights. Think about what equipment will help when you reach the next floor.

pages.title: Dirty Palace Cleaning
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Dirty Palace Cleaning begins after a party leaves the palace in a mess. Dust surfaces, wash away dirt and throw out the garbage as you work through three rooms. Finish the current room to unlock another. Check what still needs cleaning before moving on and get the palace ready for its next guests.

pages.title: Kung Fu Fight : Beat 'em up
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Kung Fu Fight : Beat 'em up has enemies approaching from both sides of the screen. React to the side that needs attention and use punches, kicks or weapons to stop the attackers. Special moves include a dragon combo. Keep the fighters from crowding you as you work toward the boss.

pages.title: Jungle Plumber Challenge 2
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Jungle Plumber Challenge 2 gives you pipe sections to connect in the jungle. Tap a piece to rotate it and join the open ends into a continuous water route. Plan the connection before you turn several pieces, since each move reduces the timer. Finish the pipe before using up the time you need for a good score.

pages.title: Ninja Adventure: relax time
pages.creator: LDGEngineering
pages.description: Ninja Adventure: relax time asks you to build bridges from one block to the next. Judge the gap before deciding how far the bridge should reach, then send the ninja across. Each landing gives you another distance to measure. Keep making connections so the ninja can continue along the route.

pages.title: Colorgama
pages.creator: ArtBit
pages.description: Colorgama shows you a target color and asks you to find the tile that matches it. Look across the choices and compare the shades before selecting one. Keep identifying the right colors as the game continues and try to improve your score. The challenge is seeing the differences quickly.

pages.title: Spider Solitaire Original
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Spider Solitaire Original asks you to arrange cards in descending order and complete runs from king to ace. Move cards between columns to uncover ones you need, then remove completed runs to make room. Think about what each move will expose before drawing more cards. Clear the tableau to finish the game.

pages.title: My Adventure Book 2
pages.creator: Kizi
pages.description: My Adventure Book 2 is a point-and-click mystery told in three chapters. Explore each location, pick up items and look for clues in the scene. Some objects are needed to solve puzzles or open the way to another location. Keep track of what you find as you work through the story.

pages.title: Princess Leia: Good or Evil
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Princess Leia: Good or Evil gives you two wardrobes to try on Leia. Start with lighter choices such as a white or pastel dress, then add sandals or a cape. Switch to the darker look to try black and red clothes, including leather pieces. See how the accessories change each version.

pages.title: Annie Dress Design
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Annie Dress Design lets you build a dress by choosing the shoulders, top, belt and skirt separately. Pick a color for each part, then choose patterns for the finished design. Try different combinations until the pieces work together. You can change individual sections as you put the dress together for Annie.

pages.title: Poke FLY
pages.creator: Funmoth Games
pages.description: Poke FLY is an arcade game about keeping a ball in play. Tap to bounce the ball and clear the walls as you go. Time each tap around the ball's movement and the obstacles ahead. The game gets faster as your score climbs, leaving you less time to react on each bounce.

pages.title: Sery Date Night Dolly Dress Up H5
pages.creator: GlossyPlay
pages.description: Sery Date Night Dolly Dress Up H5 gives you mystery boxes filled with fashion choices for Sery's date. Open the boxes, then choose clothes, hairstyles and accessories from what you find. Build the outfit around a piece you like and see which details work with it. Finish the look before Sery heads out.
